title: Mario's glove seen on the shiny floor of the craft
place_text: Aboard craft, Ellsworth AFB missile field, South Dakota

tellings.quote: I was lying down somewhere and there was a glove on a floor, a real shiny floor, nothing like the inside of that truck.
Then he said something that shocked me: He said he saw my mittens on the floor, next to where he was lying down, as he was hearing the voices.

plain: In 1977, at a nuclear missile field run from Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, two young Air Force guards say they were taken aboard a craft, and one of them remembers a small detail: a glove lying on a shiny floor. Michael Johnson, an Air Force veteran who says he was there, tells Michels that he was lying down somewhere and saw "a glove on a floor, a real shiny floor, nothing like the inside of that truck" they had been riding in. He links the glove to his fellow guard, Mario Woods. The same detail turns up in an article by Robert Hastings, a journalist who writes about UFOs and nuclear weapons sites, published on 10 September 2017 under the title "Former USAF Missile Security Policeman Tells of Apparent UFO Abduction at ICBM Site". There the man whose mittens they were recalls the moment his colleague told him: "He said he saw my mittens on the floor, next to where he was lying down, as he was hearing the voices." So one teller is a witness speaking for himself on the show, and the other is a journalist quoting a second witness years earlier. The point of the glove is that, if both men remember it, it would place them in the same strange room at the same time, which is why they tell it.
